description: Find a Colombian collective investment fund (fondo de inversión colectiva, FIC) by name. Accepts the fund or the fiduciaria / management company in any case, with or without accents, in any word order (e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente", "fondo abierto bancolombia"). Returns ranked candidates with entity, fund name and fund_code, or found:false with the closest fund names when nothing matches. Source: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

name.description: Fund name, or fund manager name, e.g. "Fiducoldex Capital Inteligente".
